snippet.title: Rooms of War - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW in early access on itch.io: https://corruptsectorhq.itch.io/rooms-of-war

A real war, fought at toy height. Toy-sized soldiers. Full-sized firefights.
Bears versus gnomes battle across a child's playroom, a brick-built town and a backyard sandbox: climb the dresser cord, snipe from the top drawer, storm the school bus, and carry the flag home. Team Deathmatch, Domination and Capture the Flag; Assault, Medic, Support and Recon classes.
More: https://corruptsectorstudios.com/row
Corrupt Sector Studios
Music: "Crusader" by Scott Buckley – released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
